title: Space Mission Design Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Mission constraints, orbital models, communications, power budgets, and mission analyses. The Space Mission Design Database documents how space missions are designed: the constraints (mass, power, delta-v, communications), the orbital mechanics, the subsystem budgets, and the analyses that prove the design closes. Every mission is a system of budgets that must all balance — mass, power, link, propellant, thermal — and each record shows the budgets, the margins, and the trades that were made.

title: Space Mission Design Database — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Orbital mechanics: vis-viva v^2 = mu(2/r - 1/a); Hohmann transfer delta-v = |v1 - v_transfer_peri| + |v_transfer_apo - v2|; plane changes are expensive (delta-v = 2v sin(theta/2)). Budgets: mass (with margin: 15-30% at concept stage), power (generation - consumption > 0 in worst eclipse, battery sized for it), link (Friis: received power from transmit power, gains, path loss (4 pi d/lambda)^2; margin >= 3dB), propellant (Tsiolkovsky: delta-v = Isp g0 ln(m0/mf)). Subsystems: propulsion, power, comms, ADCS (attitude), thermal, structure, payload, harness — each with mass/power/cost. Trade method: weighted scoring on cost/risk/performance with the weights stated. Risk: likelihood x consequence, with mitigations.

demo.title: Execution: A* pathfinding on a grid
demo.code: const grid=[[0,0,0,1],[0,1,0,0],[0,0,0,0]];const W=4,H=3;function h(a,b){return Math.abs(a[0]-b[0])+Math.abs(a[1]-b[1]);}function astar(s,g){const open=[{p:s,f:h(s,g),c:0}],came={},cost={[s]:0};while(open.length){open.sort((a,b)=>a.f-b.f);const cur=open.shift();if(cur.p[0]===g[0]&&cur.p[1]===g[1]){const path=[g];let k=g+'';while(came[k]){path.unshift(came[k]);k=came[k]+'';}return path;}for(const [dx,dy] of [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]){const n=[cur.p[0]+dx,cur.p[1]+dy];if(n[0]<0||n[1]<0||n[0]>=H||n[1]>=W||grid[n[0]][n[1]])continue;const nc=cur.c+1;if(cost[n+'']===undefined||nc<cost[n+'']){cost[n+'']=nc;came[n+'']=cur.p;open.push({p:n,f:nc+h(n,g),c:nc});}}}}const path=astar([0,0],[2,3]);J({steps:path.length-1});assert(path.length-1===5,'astar');

title: Space Mission Design Database — Verification: tests and limitations
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Tests: orbital test (Hohmann math matches known transfers); budget test (margins applied correctly); link test (Friis equation verified); determinism test. Limitations: conceptual designs only; real trajectories need high-fidelity propagators; margins are guidelines. Every design states its fidelity level and open risks.

demo.title: Execution: Hohmann transfer delta-v
demo.code: const mu=398600;function circ(r){return Math.sqrt(mu/r);}const r1=6678,r2=42164;const a=(r1+r2)/2;const dv1=Math.abs(Math.sqrt(mu*(2/r1-1/a))-circ(r1));const dv2=Math.abs(circ(r2)-Math.sqrt(mu*(2/r2-1/a)));J({dv1:+dv1.toFixed(2),dv2:+dv2.toFixed(2),total:+(dv1+dv2).toFixed(2)});assert(dv1+dv2>3.8&&dv1+dv2<4.0,'hohmann');
